info.title: Expect Less Output local agent API
info.description: Runs inside the Expect Less Output app on 127.0.0.1 only. Off until the owner turns it on in Settings. Send the token as "Authorization: Bearer <token>". Scheduled posts only go out while the app is running. Agents can never connect accounts, change credentials, or delete files.

servers.description: Default port. The owner can change it in Settings.

get.summary: List brands with their slots, defaults and connected platforms.

connected.description: True when a real account is connected. False means a dry run placeholder.

403.description: Not allowed. For example code drafts_only while agents are limited to drafts.

get.summary: The next open posting slots for a brand (slots already taken by scheduled posts are skipped).

schema.description: Start looking after this time. Defaults to now.

400.description: The request did not match the schema.

403.description: Not allowed. For example code drafts_only while agents are limited to drafts.

post.summary: Create a post from a video file. Creates a draft unless agents are allowed to schedule.
post.description: The video is copied into the brand Queue folder. While the app setting "Agents may create drafts only" is on, asking for status scheduled or next_slot true is refused with HTTP 403 and code drafts_only. Nothing is silently downgraded.

brand_id.description: Brand to post for. See GET /v1/brands.

file_path.description: Absolute path to an .mp4 or .mov file on this Mac. It is COPIED into the brand Queue folder. The original is never moved or deleted.

title.description: Defaults to the file name, cleaned up.

caption.description: Shared caption. Defaults to the brand's caption template filled in with the title and the default hashtag set.

platforms.description: Defaults to every platform that is connected for the brand.

caption_overrides.description: Per-platform caption that replaces the shared one.

ai_flags.description: AI-generated disclosure per platform. Defaults to the brand's defaults.

privacy.description: One of the privacy options TikTok allows for the account, for example SELF_ONLY or PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE.

consent.description: True only if the owner has agreed to TikTok's consent line (Music Usage Confirmation). Do not set this on the owner's behalf.

tiktok.description: Choices for a TikTok Direct Post. Not needed for Drafts mode.

thumb_offset_ms.description: Instagram cover frame, milliseconds from the start.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 date and time WITH a zone offset or Z.

next_slot.description: Use the brand's next open slot. Not allowed while agents are limited to drafts.

status.description: draft (default) or scheduled. Scheduled is refused with 403 while agents are limited to drafts.
